Dr. Nicole' L Felton Ph.D.

About the author

Dr. Felton is a published author, adjunct professor of psychology of 15 years, and a Therapeutic Coach. She is a Marine Corps disabled veteran and has worked as a psychotherapist in two large in-patient treatment facilities helping children and adults (male and female) struggling with trauma, eating disorders and behavior and emotional disorders. Dr. Felton has extensive training working with adults, teens, and children struggling with varying forms of trauma, eating disorders, domestic abuse, and behavior and emotional disorders in children. Her therapeutic techniques include Cognitive Behavior Therapy, Art, Play, and Sand Tray therapies. She has a Ph.D. in Counseling Psychology, a Master’s Degree in Human Relations and a Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology. Dr. Felton's published dissertation focuses on The Effects on Children Witnessing Abuse.
